Naftazone (BAN, rINN) Naftazona; Naftazonum. 1,2-Naphthoquinone 2-semicarbazone. Нафтазон C11H9N3O2 = 215.2. CAS — 15687-37-3. Profile Naftazone is a haemostatic, and is reported to increase venous tone and have a capillary stabilising effect. It has been used in venous insufficiency of the lower limbs and diabetic retinopathy, in oral doses of 30 mg daily. It was formerly given by injection.
